changes: Optional host-managed delivery action, exposed to the model only when configured; fixed executor and current-Run source business receipt, target, path and SHA checks before execution.
At most one action attempt per Run, including failure or timeout; action executor cannot be invoked as an artifact verifier.
Explicit local artifact subset verification can succeed without certifying whole-task completion; model receives local business gaps before cloud publication guidance.
Known observed cloud endpoint and export CLI shell calls, including directly referenced workspace scripts, are refused before execution in managed profiles.

Generic publisher writes an attempt marker before its single create request and persists the successful public ID before readback; retries with an existing matching receipt are read-only and management credentials are discarded.
Production rule runtime preserves empty positional class URLs and complete HTTP resource paths containing spaces in both HTTP client and fetch worker.

Replacement oracle accepts production search fallback and annotated share commands, creates its private import directory and verifies category semantics and source identity. Old frozen attempts and oracles remain preserved.
Three rule-engineer Skill mirrors now describe local-first acceptance and managed publication; these are manually authored generic platform improvements, not automatically promoted learning.

Generic read requests for canonical files within the currently selected Skill root are routed to the existing skill_tool read action. Read aliases, line ranges and origin metadata are preserved. Ordinary files, writes, shadowed skills and escaping links keep their existing workspace boundary.

After an action attempt, foreground guidance now names missing required artifacts and requests full verification instead of suggesting publication again. A focused finalization profile fixes --reuse-only so it cannot create a cloud entry even if the old receipt disappears.

The original Hub rule passes the replacement production oracle after those runtime fixes without changing its business implementation. Prior worker failed/cancelled states, documentation overclaims and the unauthorized dummy cloud write are not excused or rewritten.
